Unlink removes link only — blob stays in library.
No PWA share-target required for v0;
OS paste + file picker is enough.

Storage vendor? RBAC? Retire grace vs hard delete? Backup = manifest first?
Status: documentation only — no product code.
F. Paste conflict · text vs image
You are focused in a text field. What should we do?
If clipboard is image-only (no text), skip chooser and open capture sheet.
Avoid always-on global overlay (high surprise cost).
Do not overload Asset / WorkArtifactLink / DesignArtifactLink.
Inspiration: cursor-mobile paste → Draw on it → PNG bake;
destination = hub library + links, not agent chat.
ADMIN+ · browse / search / usage / retire · not a per-screen silo
Quota: 128 MB used / soft limit 2 GB · Retire unused (>90d, 0 links) bulk action
Hard delete requires confirm; prefer backup first. Audit log on retire / purge / backup.
Pickers on entity screens exclude RETIRED by default.
“Links” drawer lists Feature / Requirement / Initiative / Demand / Intake usages.
Same library powers Link from library on panel C.
v0.5 ship target for this screen; v0 can ship entity capture without full admin table.
ADMIN+ · tenant-scoped export · retire is soft by default
Unlink (EDITOR) → Retire (ADMIN) → Backup (ADMIN) → Hard delete (ADMIN, rare).
Never cascade-delete blobs when one entity unlinks. Cross-workspace sharing is out of scope.
Used on Requirement / Feature / Intake · reuse without re-upload
Creates AttachmentLink only — no new blob.
Without Admin Artifacts, the library becomes a dark archive:
• Orphaned uploads after unlink with no owner UI
• No way to free storage or retire PII / obsolete mocks
• No tenant-level backup for evidence used in audits
• Agents/MCP need stable ids; ops need exportability
Capture UX (A–C) and Admin lifecycle (G–H) are one platform,
shipped in phases — not two unrelated features.
